reviewMethod: Author self-reviewed all 326 translation strings directly against the Japanese canonical text, without reading peer outputs. Automated checks verified session IDs, entry keys, exact sourceJa, locale completeness, nonempty translations, digit sequences and absence of Japanese script in translated text. One Hindi grammatical phrase in session 288 was corrected during review.
limitations: No independent native-language reviewer or peer reviewer was used. Technical names are transliterated where appropriate; 山留め is rendered as excavation retaining/support arrangements.
